requirement:
{impl}`requirements.configuration.feature_sections`
`--config <name>` MUST select a configuration for that invocation. Otherwise,
authoring MUST use the user's selection for the canonical project root, then the
workspace default, then the user's default. Named workspace configurations MUST
override same-named user configurations as complete records. Backend, model,
connection settings, and options MUST come from the selected record as a unit;
fields MUST NOT be merged between records. Workspace-only authoring MUST work
without a user configuration file. Missing configuration or an unknown selection
MUST identify the relevant configuration file and point to documented examples.

An explicit Bedrock AWS profile or region MUST override the corresponding SDK
default; omitted values MUST use standard AWS SDK resolution. Ollama MUST use
its configured endpoint or `http://localhost:11434`. If `api_key_env` is set, its
named variable MUST supply the credential; a missing or empty value MUST produce
an error before a model request. OpenAI MUST use its configured endpoint or
`https://api.openai.com/v1`, and MUST resolve `OPENAI_API_KEY` when neither
`api_key` nor `api_key_env` is supplied.
rationale:
## Judgment

The implementation and referenced tests satisfy `requirements.authoring.configuration_precedence`.

## Obligations and coverage

1. **An explicit configuration selects the invocation's record.** `src/main.rs#fn[main]` forwards `config` to single and batch authoring. `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[configured_assessment]` and `src/authoring/batch.rs#fn[run_batch]` call the shared resolver. `src/config.rs#fn[resolve_authoring_with_workspace_from]` checks the explicit name first. Covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]` and `tests/configuration.rs#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]`.
2. **Otherwise use the user's canonical-root selection; then the workspace default; then the user default.** The same resolver canonicalizes the root and implements these three successive fallbacks. The two tests above assert canonical-root selection and each precedence level, including explicit selection over a project selection.
3. **Workspace records override same-named user records completely. Backend, model, connection settings, and options each come from the selected record; fields are not merged.** The resolver first looks up the entire workspace record, falls back to the user record only when absent, and clones its backend as a unit. `tests/configuration.rs#fn[workspace_defaults_and_configs_combine_with_existing_user_selections]` asserts replacement backend/model, absent endpoint, replacement options without inherited options, and absent inherited concurrency. `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]` also checks selected connection settings and their absence in another record. `tests/configuration.rs#fn[workspace_configurations_accept_validate_and_override_concurrency]` verifies whole-record concurrency replacement.
4. **Workspace-only authoring works without a user file.** `src/config.rs#fn[load_user_config]` returns `None` for an absent file, and the resolver accepts a workspace record independently. Covered directly by the workspace/default test above and end-to-end by `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]`.
5. **Missing configuration identifies the relevant file and points to documented examples. Unknown selections likewise identify the relevant file and point to examples.** The resolver's missing, unselected, and unknown-name diagnostics include file context and `src/config.rs#const[CONFIG_EXAMPLES]`. Covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[explicit_project_and_default_selections_choose_whole_configs]`, `tests/configuration.rs#fn[configurations_without_any_selection_report_how_to_choose_one]`, and `tests/configuration.rs#fn[unknown_selections_name_the_file_that_made_them]`, including dangling project, user-default, workspace-default, and explicit selections.
6. **Explicit Bedrock profile overrides SDK defaults; explicit region overrides SDK defaults; omitted profile and omitted region use standard SDK resolution.** `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[bedrock_sdk_config]` starts with the standard SDK loader; `src/authoring/providers.rs#fn[bedrock_sdk_loader]` applies only supplied overrides. `src/authoring/providers.rs#mod[tests]/fn[omitted_bedrock_profile_and_region_use_standard_sdk_resolution]` compares omitted/profile cases against SDK resolution and asserts region override. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]` verifies selected credentials and region in signed requests; `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[all_adapters_preserve_prompt_tools_and_evidence_with_default_connections]` verifies the default chain.
7. **Ollama uses its configured endpoint, or `http://localhost:11434` when omitted.** `src/config.rs#impl[OllamaConfig]/fn[endpoint]` implements both cases, and `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider]/fn[connect]` supplies that endpoint to the client. Covered by `tests/configuration.rs#fn[backend_configuration_round_trips_without_materializing_defaults]` and the configured-endpoint requests in `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]`.
8. **A named `api_key_env` supplies the credential; a missing value errors before a model request; an empty value errors before a model request.** `src/config.rs#impl[OllamaConfig]/fn[api_key_from]` and `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[api_key_from]` resolve and reject absent/empty values. `RigProvider::connect` resolves credentials before constructing a requesting client. Positive credential assertions occur in the Ollama CLI test above and `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[openai_responses_replays_tool_calls_and_records_usage]`. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[missing_or_empty_api_key_env_fails_before_any_model_request]` exercises both failure cases for both providers and asserts no endpoint connection. The corresponding configuration tests also directly assert credential resolution.
9. **OpenAI uses its configured endpoint, or `https://api.openai.com/v1` when omitted; it resolves `OPENAI_API_KEY` when neither credential field is supplied.** `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[endpoint]` and `src/config.rs#impl[OpenAiConfig]/fn[api_key_from]` implement these rules, applied by `RigProvider::connect`. `tests/configuration.rs#fn[openai_configuration_preserves_model_and_resolves_credentials]` asserts both endpoints and the default variable name. The OpenAI CLI tests above verify configured endpoint requests and both named and default environment credentials.

The resolver is reachable through the marked `resolve_authoring_from` and authoring roots; provider connection is reachable through `main` → single authoring → `configured_assessment` → `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[configured_record]`. The tests cited here carry subject references. No unmet obligation or acknowledged gap was found.
